metadata.title: Dynamical and evolutionary constraints on the nature and origin of hypervelocity stars

notes: No individually identifiable star meets the eligibility rules. The paper refers to unbound HVSs only as inferred populations ("some of them unbound to the Galaxy," T:p1-b6; an assumed total of ~100 unbound HVSs, T:p2-b2). It discusses unidentified subsets, such as four B-type MS HVSs and one subdwarf O HVS (T:p1-b6), but supplies no stellar name or source identifier for any particular star; its analysis is theoretical and population-level.
